visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a vibrant outdoor flower market with a woman in a black shirt looking at various colorful bouquets. Rows of bright pink, yellow, and white flowers fill the background under bright natural light. (2) Inside a home, the camera focuses on hands wrapping pink carnations and red anthuriums in brown kraft paper on a white table. Tape, scissors, and a smartphone are nearby. (3) The woman is outside near a dark car, putting on a beige blazer over a white shirt and navy shorts. She picks up a large jute bag containing the wrapped flowers and a red card. (4) A close-up shot shows the interior of the jute bag, highlighting the red anthuriums and carnations against the beige fabric. (5) The woman walks through a hallway, speaking directly to the camera in a selfie style, appearing cheerful with pink eye makeup and a smile. (6) In an office setting, she stands holding the bouquet; she notices a small tear in one of the large red flowers and reacts with a surprised expression. (7) She is now seated in a modern office across from an older man in a navy suit and red tie. They are engaged in a friendly conversation with a book on a small round table between them. (8) A camera monitor is shown filming the two people, indicating a professional recording session in progress. (9) The woman and the man are shown in a close-up, laughing and gesturing during their conversation. (10) The woman is back outside, speaking into the camera and smiling, signaling the end of the day's task.
